initial_assumptions: Full high-penetrance pathogenic mutation (same codon as p.Arg1699Trp)

evidence_schedule.content: ENIGMA guideline: Intermediate-risk alleles with partial activity (10-30%) must not be classified as classical high-penetrance Pathogenic.
Family segregation shows co-occurrence in trans with classical pathogenic BRCA1 mutation without embryonic lethality.
INCOMPLETE PENETRANCE: Large international pooled consortium shows cumulative breast cancer risk to age 70 is only ~20% (moderate penetrance), contradicting classical high-risk assumption.
Diagnostic laboratory updates reporting policy: variant classified with Special Clinical Significance / VUS-intermediate penetrance allele.

ground_truth.provenance: Famous ENIGMA intermediate allele classified formally as VUS / moderate risk.
